certificates.title: Medical certificates
certificates.hint: Sick leave, medical reports and attendance certificates. Issued certificates cannot be edited; void and issue a new one.
certificates.issueHint: The certificate is issued in your name with the next number.
certificates.emptyHint: Issue a sick leave, a medical report or an attendance certificate.
certificates.voidHint: The certificate stays on file marked as void. This cannot be undone.
certificates.immutableHint: Once issued, a certificate cannot be changed. Check the dates and text before issuing.

templates.sick_leave_one: This is to certify that {{name}} was examined at our clinic and is advised to rest for {{count}} day, on {{from}}.
templates.sick_leave_other: This is to certify that {{name}} was examined at our clinic and is advised to rest for {{count}} days, from {{from}} to {{to}}.
templates.medical_report: This report is issued at the request of {{name}} and describes their dental condition and treatment at our clinic.
templates.attendance: This is to certify that {{name}} attended a dental appointment at our clinic on {{from}}.

instructions.hint: Care instructions given to the patient after treatment. The text is kept as it was given.
instructions.giveHint: Pick a template, adjust the text for this patient, then print it or let them read it in the portal.
instructions.emptyHint: Give post-treatment instructions after an extraction, filling, root canal…
instructions.title: Title
instructions.templatesHint: Templates the dentists give to patients. A template is suggested when one of its procedure codes was performed today.
instructions.seededHint: A default template: saving it keeps your wording instead of the translated default.
instructions.procedureCodesHint: Type a code and press Enter, e.g. D7140.
